title: Great tour!
text: Tour was straight forward and wonderful.  Guide was very knowledgeable, and so friendly.  We hade time to walk on our own.  Over all- very enjoyable.
author: Karen_D

title: Absolutely excellent!!
text:
Great timing with the morning -- nice lighting and no/minimal crowds.
Sophie is a superb tour guide. Very knowledgeable, professional, courteous and informative.
Rafa is an excellent driver. The Mercedes van was new, very clean and comfy. Classy!
Montserrat is a ""do not miss experience!"
author: Brenda_B

title: Montserrat trip was well worth the effort and expense.
text: Lesly was a great tour guide for our trip to Montserrat followed by wine tasting and small plate lunch. She was a great teacher of history for us. Montserrat was beautiful and interesting. We enjoyed the trip!
author: barbarabY1484FO

title: Montserrat is a must and Carlos was a great tour guide
text: Montserrat is a must see and takes you out of the city for so much history. Carlos was an excellent tour guide and also gave us leisurely free time. Would highly recommend this tour in the morning when less crowded.
author: Elizabeth_P

title: Montserrat trip
text: Excellent experience with Hugo! Outstanding guide! Wonderful day, very informative and knowledgeable
author: William_A

title: Fabulous Montserrat visit
text: Wonderful experience. Planned well and great to beat the rush. Comfortable van and very informative. We thoroughly enjoyed the half day Montserrat visit. Our guide Carlos was an excellent host and went out of his way to help us enjoy the experience.
author: Godfrey_E

title: Magnificent monsarrat!
text:

Considered a magic
Mountain with the monastery basilica and so much more!  Our
Tour guide Carlos was very friendly knowledgeable and professional. We also enjoyed the ride in the countryside   The museum was interesting. The
Mountain itself spectacular.  The driver was courteous and a safe driver. The only surprise was having to pay an additional 18 euros after the tour for “tickets”. I recommend this tour highly
author: Debbie_C

title: A Great Day for a Half Day Tour
text: It was a cold and windy day, blustery even,  but the mountain was beautiful and Sofia was an excellent guide, competent, conscientious, and gracious.   We were her only two customers that morning but she gave us her all.
author: jeanneconlin

title: Great Experience
text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Sophie was an absolutely wonderful guide in Montserrat. She was warm, knowledgeable, and passionate, bringing the history, culture, and spiritual beauty of the mountain to life. Her explanations were clear and engaging, and she made the experience feel both personal and memorable. We truly couldn’t have asked for a better guide—highly recommended!
author: CarlosLuxHomes

title: Beautiful experience
text: Very nice driver and guide. Comfortable car very spacious. Good pace and felt relaxed. Even stayed with my mom who was walking slower.
author: Tso Chun W
